title: dep-scan validate output
description: The document `depscan validate --format json` writes on stdout: one result per given file, in the order the files were given. An invalid input document is a result, not an error: the verb exits 1 with this document, and a document that could not be read at all is a result with its reason among the errors. A failure that stops the verb as a whole produces the error document instead.

results.description: One entry per given file, in the given order.

file.description: The file that was validated, absolute and normalised, with / as the separator on every platform.

format.description: The document format the detection settled on, csaf or cyclonedx, or the string unknown when neither matched. Null when the file could not be read as JSON at all.

valid.description: Whether the document passed its schema and, for CSAF, the mandatory semantic tests.

errors.description: Every reason the document failed, empty when it is valid.
